content.text:
**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Licence grant scope**

The Article II grant runs to the Licensee only, and the restrictions limit use/access to Licensee's *employees* (p0045) and bar third-party access without Licensor's discretionary consent (p0041/p0042). Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are excluded with no notice-based path — below the fallback. Transfer is also blocked: p0149 requires Licensor consent, and a Change of Control auto-terminates the licence absent consent (p0134), so there is no successor-transfer right in an M&A transaction.

Redline (validated, preferred position):
- p0030 — grant extended to "its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf".
- p0041 / p0045 — carve Affiliates and contractors (under equivalent confidentiality) out of the third-party and employees-only access restrictions.
- p0149 — consent-free assignment to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of substantially all assets/equity.

Noted but not flagged here (belongs to the termination rule): Article IV allows immediate termination on *any* breach with no materiality threshold or cure period, which makes the licence close to revocable at will.
